subject: Geopolitics
title: Supply Chain Chokepoints
description: A quick, practical guide to Supply Chain Chokepoints.

hook.text: China refines 70% of the world's lithium. If it stops exporting, the global EV industry halts overnight.

buildup.text: Supply chains have chokepoints — single sources that the whole world depends on. Disrupt one and cascades follow.

discovery.text: Nations weaponize chokepoints. China restricted rare earths to Japan in 2010 during a territorial dispute.

twist.text: COVID exposed how fragile global supply chains are. Chips, medicines, and food all bottlenecked simultaneously.

climax.text: Diversification is the cure, but it's slow and expensive. Nations talk reshoring, but few can do it at scale.

punchline.text: One broken link can freeze the entire chain.

quiz.question: Why did China restrict rare earth exports to Japan in 2010?
options: To reduce environmental damage from mining
In retaliation during a territorial dispute
